text.title: Reply Text
text.description: The assistant's reply (already extracted — map this directly downstream).

json.title: JSON
json.description: The reply parsed as JSON, when the reply is a JSON object/array (otherwise empty). Use this instead of a parse script.

finish_reason.title: Finish Reason
finish_reason.description: Why generation stopped, e.g. "stop", "length", or "tool_calls" when the model wants to call a tool.

message.title: Message
message.description: The full assistant message object (role, content, and tool_calls if any). Append this to your conversation history for multi-turn tool use.

tool_calls.title: Tool Calls
tool_calls.description: The tool calls the model requested, if any — each has id, type, and function.{name,arguments}. Empty when the model answered directly.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that actually served the request.
